entities.summary: Aleksan Nalbandyan is an Armenian and Russian amateur boxer. He was a runner-up at the 2004 Acropolis Cup. Nalbandyan won a gold medal at the 1st AIBA European 2004 Olympic Qualifying Tournament. He competed at the 2004 Summer Olympics in the light flyweight division.
